_style: realistic cinematic creature foley, film sound design, close-mic, high quality, no music, no voices

growl.prompt: huge dragon low growl, deep guttural throat rumble of a giant reptile, menacing breath

roar.prompt: massive dragon roar, enormous beast bellowing, deep powerful roar with throat rasp and cave echo

cavern.prompt: steady constant low cave room tone, continuous dark rumbling ambience with soft distant water drips, even level, no sudden sounds

fire_burst.prompt: fire igniting with a deep whoomp, flames bursting to life and roaring inside an enclosed space

gurgle.prompt: large animal stomach gurgling and rumbling during digestion, wet churning belly sounds

bubble.prompt: thick fermenting liquid bubbling, slow wet bubbles rising and popping in a vat of rotting mush

chew.prompt: large animal chewing a mouthful of wet leaves and stalks, crunchy wet chomping, big jaws

burp.prompt: cow burping, short low lazy belch from a large animal

candle.prompt: candle flame fluttering in a small puff of air, soft flicker and tiny whoosh

pressurize.prompt: gas being pumped into a pressurized tank, rising pneumatic hiss with a tight squeeze

squeeze.prompt: wet fleshy muscle contracting and squeezing, organic squelch and stretch

spark_small.prompt: single tiny ember spark crackling and drifting, faint crackle

explosion.prompt: huge fireball explosion, deep concussive boom with roaring flames and debris, cinematic

sizzle.prompt: flesh burning in intense fire, aggressive sizzle and crackle with a hot hiss

iron_clack.prompt: heavy iron jaws snapping shut, metallic teeth clashing together with a sharp clang

spark.prompt: flint striking steel, bright shower of sparks crackling

gas_hiss.prompt: pressurized gas venting from a nozzle, steady sharp hiss

flashback.prompt: flame rushing backwards down a pipe, fast fiery whoosh sucked inward with a roar

flamethrower.prompt: roaring flamethrower jet, powerful continuous blast of fire with turbulent roar

rocket.prompt: rocket engine firing on a test stand, thunderous roaring exhaust with crackle

stove.prompt: gas stove burner igniting, click click then a soft blue flame whoomp and steady gentle hiss
